acf.procut: Leading PTFE Gasket Manufacturer for Industrial Sealing Solutions PTFE gaskets are high-performance industrial sealing solutions widely used in chemical processing, oil and gas, petrochemical plants, pharmaceutical production, and food processing industries where excellent chemical resistance and reliable sealing are required. Asian Sealing Products is a trusted PTFE gasket manufacturer and supplier in India, producing precision-engineered PTFE gaskets designed for corrosive chemicals, high temperatures, and demanding industrial environments. Manufactured from high-quality Polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE), these gaskets provide outstanding resistance to acids, solvents, alkalis, and aggressive media. In addition to PTFE gaskets, we also manufacture CNAF (Compressed Non-Asbestos Fibre) gaskets, designed for steam systems, boilers, water lines, and general industrial sealing applications requiring strong compression and mechanical durability. Our PTFE and CNAF gaskets are manufactured according to ASME, DIN, ANSI, and IS flange standards, ensuring leak-free sealing performance, operational safety, and long service life in critical piping and flange connections.
acf.key_features_title: Your Trusted Partner for Reliable Sealing Solutions

key_feature_marquee_lf_to_rt.key_feature_marquee_lf_to_rt_content: Our PTFE gaskets provide outstanding resistance to acids, solvents, alkalis, and corrosive fluids, making them ideal for chemical processing, petrochemical plants, and aggressive industrial environments.
PTFE and CNAF gaskets perform reliably across a broad temperature range from -200°C to +260°C, ensuring stable sealing in both cryogenic and high-temperature applications.

key_feature_marquee_lf_to_rt.key_feature_marquee_lf_to_rt_title: Low Friction and Non Stick Surface
key_feature_marquee_lf_to_rt.key_feature_marquee_lf_to_rt_content: PTFE gaskets feature a naturally smooth, low-friction surface that reduces wear, prevents media build-up, and extends equipment life in chemical lines, water systems, and processing units.
We offer FDA compliant PTFE gaskets suitable for food processing, beverage production, and pharmaceutical industries, ensuring contamination free and non asbestos safe sealing performance.

acf.application_description: Asian Sealing Products manufactures PTFE gaskets and CNAF gaskets for a wide range of demanding industrial applications. PTFE gaskets offer excellent chemical resistance and thermal stability, making them ideal for chemical processing plants, pharmaceutical manufacturing, food and beverage processing, and other critical process systems handling corrosive media. CNAF gaskets are widely used in steam pipelines, boilers, refineries, marine systems, and general industrial piping where strong compression, durability, and reliable high-pressure sealing are required. Both gasket types ensure safe, leak-free sealing and long-term performance in challenging industrial environments.

gasket_applications.gasket_applications_sub_points: •  PTFE gasket provides high-purity sealing for medical devices and drug production.
• PTFE gaskets are used in pipelines and chemical storage for leak-proof sealing.
•  Using PTFE gaskets in these industries ensures contamination-free processing with FDA-compliant materials.
•  A PTFE gasket enhances durability in fuel systems and engine components.
• CNAF gaskets provide reliable sealing in pipelines, refineries, and offshore platforms.
• CNAF gasket ensures heat and pressure resistance for uninterrupted operation.
• Using CNAF gaskets prevents leaks in water, fuel, and hydraulic systems.
• Non-asbestos Gaskets offers strong sealing solutions for extreme operational environments.

acf.gaskets_materials_descriptions: PTFE and CNAF gaskets are manufactured using specialized materials selected according to operating conditions, fluid compatibility, temperature, and pressure requirements. These materials are engineered to provide strong compression, thermal stability, and leak-free sealing performance in demanding industrial environments. The choice of gasket material plays a critical role in ensuring reliable sealing performance, chemical resistance, and durability in industrial applications.

gaskets_materials_types.gaskets_materials_types_content: Virgin PTFE offers excellent chemical resistance, low friction, and non-stick properties, making it ideal for highly corrosive environments and high-purity applications such as chemical processing, pharmaceuticals, and food production.
Glass-filled PTFE improves compressive strength and reduces creep (cold flow), providing better dimensional stability and sealing performance in high-pressure industrial applications.
Carbon-filled PTFE enhances thermal conductivity and wear resistance while reducing deformation under load, making it suitable for high-temperature and high-pressure sealing environments.
Expanded PTFE features a flexible micro-porous structure that provides excellent compressibility and sealing capability, especially on irregular or damaged flange surfaces.
Aramid fibres provide high tensile strength and heat resistance, serving as the primary reinforcement material in CNAF gasket sheets to ensure durability and pressure resistance.
Mineral fillers improve density, thermal stability, and resistance to pressure, enhancing the overall performance of compressed non-asbestos fibre gaskets.
Elastomer binders act as bonding agents in CNAF gasket materials, providing flexibility, compressibility, and reliable sealing integrity under varying operating conditions.

acf.gaskets_types_descriptions: At Asian Sealing Products, we manufacture a wide range of PTFE gaskets and CNAF gaskets designed for chemical processing, steam systems, and industrial pipeline sealing applications. Our product range includes industrial PTFE gaskets for general chemical and industrial sealing, corrosion-resistant PTFE gaskets suitable for aggressive chemicals and acids, and expanded PTFE (ePTFE) gaskets that provide excellent flexibility and reliable sealing on irregular flange surfaces. We also supply CNAF (Compressed Non-Asbestos Fibre) gaskets commonly used in steam, water, oil, and utility piping systems, along with reinforced graphite gaskets designed for high-temperature and high-pressure sealing applications. All gasket types are engineered to deliver reliable sealing performance and long service life in demanding industrial piping and flange connections.

products_details.products_details_tilte: PTFE Gasket Types and Their Properties
products_details.products_details_descriptions: PTFE Gasket solutions are designed for high-performance industrial applications that require chemical resistance, temperature stability, and pressure endurance. This PTFE gasket is manufactured in Virgin PTFE, Carbon-Filled PTFE, and Glass-Filled PTFE grades and offers low creep, high dielectric properties, and long service life across a wide range of operating conditions. Raised-Face PTFE Gaskets These PTFE Gaskets are designed to be used in high-pressure flange joints (high-pressure) where uniform distribution of loads is necessary, and leak-free sealing is required. Full-Face PTFE Gaskets These PTFE Gaskets are used on flat-face flanges, and they cover the whole surface of the flange, eliminate flange damage, and offer uniform chemical resistance. Custom PTFE Gaskets PTFE gasket solutions for non-standard flanges and equipment are manufactured in custom-cut forms to meet specific mechanical and sealing requirements. PTFE Envelope Gaskets This PTFE gasket combines a compressible core with chemical protection, making the gasket suitable for aggressive media under moderate pressure and temperature conditions. Expanded PTFE Gaskets (ePTFE) The ePTFE Gaskets have a micro-fibrous design that provides high compressibility, low creep, and reliable sealing of irregular or damaged flanges, with temperatures ranging between -200 °C and 260 °C.

products_details.products_details_tilte: CNAF Gasket Types and Their Properties
products_details.products_details_descriptions: The CNAF Gaskets (Compressed Non-Asbestos Fibre Gaskets) are applied in tight compressibility as well as cost-efficient sealing. These non-asbestos gaskets are made using aramid fibres, glass fibres, and elastomeric binders to ensure a good service in thermal and pressure-based systems. Aramid Fibre with NBR Binder Applicable in the oil, fuel, and hydrocarbon services, it provides stability and consistency in sealing under pressure. Glass Fibre with NBR Binder A cost-effective CNAF Gasket solution with good compression recovery in a moderate temperature and pressure environment. SBR/NR Binder CNAF Gaskets Applicable best when flexibility and low installation cost are needed, and steam, water, and boiler sealing are required.

Graphite gaskets are reinforced with a view to dealing with harsh pressure and temperature conditions. They are designed using expanded graphite, reinforced with stainless steel inserts; they are very chemically resistant and stable in dimensions. These gaskets are typically applied together with PTFE Gaskets and CNAF Gaskets in intricate sealing systems that deal with steam, oil, and chemical processing.

PTFE Gaskets are often paired with elastomer-backed systems depending on application needs:
  • Natural Rubber – High elasticity for dynamic sealing
  • Neoprene Rubber – Resistant to oil and weathering
  • Silicone Rubber – Stable at high and low temperatures, food-grade compatible
  • EPDM Rubber – Ideal for water, steam, and outdoor use
  • Butyl Rubber – Excellent gas impermeability
  • Nitrile Rubber (NBR) – Strong oil and fuel resistance
  • Viton Rubber – Premium chemical and heat resistance
  • SBR Rubber – Cost-effective for general-purpose sealing

Our product specialises in precision-engineered PTFE Gaskets that are used in critical sealing applications in chemical, petrochemical, oil and gas, boiler, and flange systems. Also included in our solutions are PTFE and CNAF Gaskets, which provide reliable sealing in high-pressure and high-temperature as well as chemically hostile conditions, where PTFE gasket performance is critical. High-tech Material Expertise Virgin PTFE, Carbon-Filled PTFE, Glass-Filled PTFE, and Expanded PTFE (ePTFE Gaskets) are used to produce our PTFE Gaskets with low creep, good dielectric properties, and high chemical resistance. Complementary Non-Asbestos Gaskets are CNAF sheet material that is guaranteed to provide controlled compressibility where needed for specific PTFE gasket applications. Designed to Operate in Extreme Conditions PTFE Gaskets are used in sealing systems that require high temperatures, cryogenic, and in food and pharmaceutical systems that are FDA-compliant. CNAF Gaskets give steady sealing to water and steam, oil, and boiler use where control of pressure is vital. Industrial Focus We have the ability to supply the petrochemical sealing, oil and gas gaskets, high-pressure flange gaskets, and chemical processing units. High-Pressure Non-Asbestos Gaskets come in at a price that fits in cost-conscious, but demanding, environments. Self-managed Gasket Choice Support A gasket selection guide is organized to assist in identifying when to apply PTFE Gaskets or CNAF Gaskets and provides a guideline to the maximum temperature, media compatibility, and pressure levels. Quality, Consistency, and Reach Our PTFE Gaskets and CNAF Gaskets are manufactured in accordance with ISO standards. They will provide consistent quality, traceability, and reliable supply with an established network of gasket manufacturers and distributors.

acf.faq_title: Answers to all your possible questions.

faq_content.faq_question: What are PTFE gaskets made of?
faq_content.faq_answer: PTFE gaskets are manufactured from Polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE), a high-performance fluoropolymer known for its exceptional chemical resistance, low friction, and high-temperature stability. Depending on the application, PTFE gasket materials may also include glass-filled PTFE, carbon-filled PTFE, or expanded PTFE (ePTFE) to improve strength, reduce creep, and enhance sealing performance.

faq_content.faq_question: What applications are PTFE and CNAF gaskets suitable for?
faq_content.faq_answer: PTFE gaskets are suitable for chemical processing, petrochemical plants, oil and gas pipelines, food and pharmaceutical industries, and high-temperature or corrosive environments. CNAF gaskets are commonly used in steam lines, boilers, water systems, compressors, and general industrial sealing applications where mechanical strength and controlled compression are required.

faq_content.faq_question: What is cold flow and how does it affect PTFE gaskets?
faq_content.faq_answer: Cold flow, also known as creep, is the tendency of PTFE material to deform gradually under constant load. In flange applications, this may reduce sealing stress over time. Using filled PTFE grades, such as glass- or carbon-filled PTFE, helps minimize cold flow and improve long-term sealing reliability.

faq_content.faq_question: . What is the difference between PTFE and CNAF gaskets in industrial applications?
faq_content.faq_answer: PTFE gaskets offer superior chemical resistance and perform well in extreme temperatures, making them ideal for corrosive environments. CNAF gaskets are better suited for steam, water, and oil applications where strength, durability, and controlled compression are required.

faq_content.faq_question: What temperature range can PTFE gaskets withstand?
faq_content.faq_answer: PTFE gaskets can operate within a temperature range of approximately -200°C to +260°C, depending on operating pressure and application conditions.
Yes, selected grades of PTFE gaskets are FDA-compliant and safe for use in food processing, beverage production, and pharmaceutical manufacturing where contamination-free sealing is required.
Yes, CNAF stands for Compressed Non-Asbestos Fibre. These gaskets are manufactured using aramid fibres and elastomers, providing safe and environmentally compliant sealing solutions.

faq_content.faq_question: Which gasket is better for chemical applications?
faq_content.faq_answer: PTFE gaskets are generally better for chemical applications because of their excellent resistance to corrosive media, acids, and solvents.

faq_content.faq_question: Do you supply custom-sized PTFE and CNAF gaskets?
faq_content.faq_answer: Yes, PTFE and CNAF gaskets can be manufactured in custom sizes and flange standards to meet specific industrial sealing requirements.

faq_content.faq_question: How do I choose the right gasket thickness?
faq_content.faq_answer: The correct gasket thickness depends on flange condition, pressure rating, bolt load, and operating temperature. Thinner gaskets are preferred for high-pressure systems, while slightly thicker gaskets may compensate for minor flange imperfections. Proper engineering evaluation ensures optimal sealing performance.

faq_content.faq_question: What media are PTFE and CNAF gaskets not suitable for?
faq_content.faq_answer: PTFE gaskets are generally not recommended for molten alkali metals or certain fluorinating agents at high temperatures. CNAF gaskets may not be suitable for highly aggressive acids or extreme chemical environments where pure PTFE offers better resistance. Always verify chemical compatibility before selection.

faq_content.faq_question: Are you a PTFE and CNAF gasket manufacturer in India?
faq_content.faq_answer: Yes, we are a PTFE gasket and CNAF gasket manufacturer in India, supplying precision-cut industrial gaskets as per ASME, DIN, and IS standards for domestic and international projects.
